column1: # The order of checks of a command and a batch POST /v1/write (P/01.1 Н2.1; ADR-0120 item 2 (a)). The norm refers to this table and does not repeat it in prose.
# The input of the table is the body already parsed as JSON by Н2.1 (HTTP framing, the body limit, RFC 8259, JSON_DEPTH — before the table). Rows in the order of n:

# the first row whose when is true gives the refusal code, kind and the fields fault; none — the command goes on to Н3. The table does not read the store state (cas and guard by value, the id memory) — that is Н3.
# op — which commands the row applies to: * — all, otherwise a comma list of values of body.op. group — consecutive rows with one group form a group:
# each binds the index and the element of a list (i, w in body.writes), the group applies to the elements in order, element i as a whole before element i + 1; no list — no elements.
# when and fault are CEL (extensions strings, two-var-comprehensions; type(), has(), matches() — standard CEL). Variables:
#var body dyn — the JSON of the body; strings carry U+FFFD instead of a lone surrogate
#var sock string — the socket role of the caller (P/01.2 Н1.1 identity): admin, console, domain or a role name
#var lone list<string> — the JSON Pointer of every string of the body with a lone surrogate; for a field name — the pointer of the object where it stands (Н2.1)
#var lim map<string,int> — the parameters of the lesson, only the names of #lim
#lim ROW_CEILING — P/01.1 Н1 row.items.ceiling: the row ceiling of the store
#fn key_ok(string) -> bool — the key rules of Н1 row.key: not empty, does not start with /, no segment .., at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes
#fn weight(map) -> int — the weight of items of Н1: the sum of UTF-8 byte lengths of all names and values
#fn finite(double) -> bool — finite in binary64 (1e400 is not)
#fn allowed(string, string, string) -> bool — the rights of the role (socket, operation read | write | delete, key): P/01.2 Н3 «check»
